europe_now.title: Fatal Rail Disaster in Spain
europe_now.summary: At least 68 people were killed and over 100 injured following a high-speed train collision in Spain. Government officials stated that the crash occurred after a train was ordered to proceed in error, prompting widespread questions regarding national rail safety standards.

sources.headline: Spain rail crash came after train ordered to go in error: minister
High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain

top_stories.title: EU and Canada Deepen Bilateral Cooperation
top_stories.summary: The European Union and Canada are working to strengthen their bilateral ties and safeguard their partnership amid changing geopolitical dynamics. Officials from both sides dropped an associate membership plan during discussions to deepen their cooperative framework.

sources.headline: Canada and EU drop associate membership plan in bid to deepen ties

top_stories.title: Border Force Surveillance Powers Face Opposition
top_stories.summary: European lawmakers have strongly criticized new powers granted to border forces to conduct surveillance on social media. The controversial measures have raised significant legal and institutional concerns regarding privacy rights.
